_about: Reviewed curation for the arusha-government-2026-09 run. Each entry records a decision a person (or the agent, marked for review) took after checking the evidence. build_government_run.py applies them; nothing here is inferred automatically.

ward_aliases._about: Spellings used by official rosters, Wikipedia titles or OpenStreetMap names, mapped to the census ward name, per council. Each was checked on 23 September 2026: the source names the same council or district, and no other ward in that council has a closer spelling.

osm_office_links._about: Reviewed links from OpenStreetMap offices to census wards when the mapped name differs from the census name.
